items.title: Native macOS process inspector
items.oneliner: Microsoft's native macOS Process Explorer shows live process trees, sockets, modules, and kill controls in one installable app.

items.title: Modern web guidance for agents
items.oneliner: CLI-ready guidance teaches coding agents modern web APIs, CSS, performance, and accessibility instead of stale 2019 JavaScript patterns.

items.title: Open guide to inference engineering
items.oneliner: Hands-on guide explains self-hosted inference stacks, latency tuning, and GPU placement, with tactics to cut serving costs substantially.

items.title: Hardware-backed SSH key setup
items.oneliner: Practical walkthrough shows how to replace disk SSH keys with YubiKey, TPM, and Secure Enclave backed credentials.

items.title: Tarball extraction edge case
items.oneliner: Deep dive into a malformed tar archive shows why GNU tar, BusyBox, and bsdtar extract the same file differently.

items.title: NetBSD desktop on Raspberry Pi
items.oneliner: Step-by-step install guide gets NetBSD 11 running on Raspberry Pi 4 with UEFI, users, and wireless setup.

items.title: Reverse engineering a cheap IP camera
items.oneliner: Firmware extraction walkthrough uses binwalk and config analysis to uncover disabled local streaming features in Tuya-based cameras.

items.title: Live internet radio developer API
items.oneliner: Real-time radio index and API enable song detection, airplay alerts, smart station switching, and other buildable audio products.

items.title: Native scrolling carousel library
items.oneliner: Lightweight web carousel adds drag support while preserving native scrolling behavior, making touch and desktop interactions feel cleaner.

items.title: Blender adds Gaussian splats
items.oneliner: Blender 5.3 can import and render Gaussian splats natively, letting developers process photogrammetry-style captures through Geometry Nodes.
